operations_list.summary: Returns a list of global router networks.

params.name: page
params.description: Number of the page to return. Default number is 1.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of elements on one page. Maximum number is 200. Default number is 20.

params.name: sort_keys
params.description: List of keys to sort results by. If there is more than one key, separate them with commas, for example, `id,name`.

params.name: sort_direction
params.description: Sorting direction. Can be `asc` or `desc`. Default direction is `asc`.

params.name: filters
params.description: List of keys in `<key>`-`<value>` format to filter results. If there is more than one key, separate them with commas.

params.name: Accept-Language
params.description: Sets language for error responses. Can be 'ru' or 'en'.
